proposal.observation: Two rounds of feedback bracket the problem. Round 1 (stage-5 geometry: K_height 845, segment_width 1215) left the label layout unchanged and cost -0.030 on correspondence_f1@15, so the SAM template is already aligned. Round 2 (relaxed detecting: binary 115, oblique 35, horizontal 28, gap 45) did NOT recover the dotted A1/B1 (~y 790) and B2/A3 (~y 2300) joint rows as horizontal lines and did not extend the K chains past x ~ 1650 (green) / ~ 2070 (red); it only added short spurious oblique fragments (green at y ~ 1930 and ~ 2150, extra red at ~ 1750, more green at 1300-1450), so line-pixels-on-boundaries fell and F1 dropped -0.021 while sam_fill_rate, ring_count_error and depth_nan_ratio were exactly unchanged. From the incumbent detected_lines.png, roughly 84% of line pixels already sit on label transitions, so F1 = 0.364 is capped by boundary-explained (~0.23) and cannot be raised through Hough thresholds: relaxing adds off-boundary fragments and tightening risks deleting the short right-hand K fragments that are the only support for the rings 6-8 boundaries. Stage 4 and 5 are therefore exhausted. The remaining unexploited feature is depth_nan_ratio = 0.131: depth_map_viridis.png shows, besides the unrecoverable top-right occlusion void, a dense field of small white holes at every bolt pocket, dotted gaps along the circumferential joint rows (y ~ 307-446, 1524-1555, 2755-2787) and speckle along the ring boundaries, i.e. holes bordered by high-curvature points where the surface up-sampler refuses to insert midpoints. denoise_retained_ratio is 0.77 and the radial band is already reasonable, and ring count (10) and the prompt row (all 'propagated' at y ~ 1550) are correct.
proposal.rule: d5 (stage_3_upsample): m_hole_ratio high -> f_depth_holes; remediation r_increase_window_or_upsample (densify the surface so voids are interpolated). In this pipeline the surface up-sampler (enhance_segment_surface) only inserts a midpoint between two neighbours when their curvature difference is <= curvature_threshold, so the threshold is the gate that keeps the edges of every bolt pocket and joint gap from being bridged; raising it is the bounded knob equivalent to a finer up-sampling step. Stage 1 is locked (unfolding untouched). Denoising is deliberately left alone because mask_r_low/high also set the depth-image vmin/vmax that SAM sees, which would perturb stage 5 in the way round 1 showed to be fragile; detecting and sam are left at incumbent because rounds 1-2 showed they are already at a local optimum for this scan.
proposal.failure_mode: f_depth_holes (stage 3): NaN voids in the unrolled depth map around bolt pockets, joint gaps and ring boundaries because the curvature gate blocks surface midpoint insertion across those edges; this directly inflates depth_nan_ratio and leaves SAM crops with white speckle that can only lower mask coverage (f_over_under_coverage downstream).
proposal.rationale: depth_nan_ratio is the only one of the four proxy features that has not yet been targeted and it is measured directly on depth_map.npy, so denser surface up-sampling acts on it without going through the noisy detection/SAM chain that defeated rounds 1 and 2. Raising enhancing.curvature_threshold from the ~0.0005 default region to 0.0012 (2.4x, still well inside [0.0002, 0.002]) lets the three-step midpoint schedule bridge the ~5-15 cm bolt-pocket and joint gaps that are bordered by high-curvature points, shrinking the interior holes while the large top-right occlusion (no neighbours to bridge) is left as is. The joint/outlier map used by stage 4 comes from enhance_outlier_points with the fixed depth thresholds, not from the curvature-gated surface densification, so the replayed line set and ring count are unaffected; the prompt row is fixed by uniform_k_snap. Fewer white voids inside the K/A/B blocks can only help SAM mask completeness (sam_fill_rate) and keeps block boundaries where they are, so correspondence_f1@15 is expected to hold. This is a single-stage, single-parameter change, so if it fails the attribution is clean, and its expected direction on the proxy (lower NaN ratio, equal or higher fill rate) is positive. Unfolding untouched; value inside bounds.
